name: mapstr
algorithm: Hash map churn with str keys of 1 to 7 bytes (wordfreq's case, SH-1): n splitmix64-generated lowercase keys, views of one buffer, inserted, each looked up once with a hit and once with a miss (its first letter upper case), every other key removed, all n looked up again; rounds times with a fresh map over the same keys (README.md).

skip.c: no standard hash map in C
skip.mk-wrap: the checksum already uses the wrapping operators; there is no checked arithmetic to remove

notes: Default string hashes: Mk the fold hash (DD-5, FoldStr), Rust SipHash-1-3 under a random key (RandomState), Zig std.hash.Wyhash with seed 0 (StringHashMap), Go the runtime string hash (AES-based with AES-NI, seeded per map).
Keys of 1 to 7 bytes repeat (there are fewer distinct ones than n at 1 to 3 bytes), so later inserts replace values; every column replays the same sequence.
Written by the std-hash lane (status/std-hash.md, session 2); checksums agree across all four columns at both sizes on the owner's machine, 2026-11-06.
